Azure architecture. The rule engine decides; the model explains and cites. No decision without human review.
Home · Dashboard · Upload · Analysis · Policy AI · Sentiment · Voice · Search · Monitoring
Account no · PAN · Aadhaar · customer ID · name
Microsoft Entra ID · DefaultAzureCredential · user-assigned managed identity id-bankai-app — no keys in code, no connection strings
QUERY PATH — retrieval and grounded generation
Azure Blob Storage / ADLS Gen2 — stbankai*
raw-documents/{policies, loan, statements, kyc} · hierarchical namespace enabled
prebuilt-read → image-only PDFs, no text layer
Thresholds traceable to policy clauses. Home Loan §3 ≥ 3 yrs · §4 ≥ INR 50,000 · §7 ≥ 700
Produces the verdict. The model never does.
Fields, per-criterion results, processing duration and status — feeds monitoring
Speech-to-text via Azure AI Speech, en-IN · aad#{resourceId}#{token} auth
1536 dimensions · query and corpus embedded with the same deployment
104 chunks · HNSW cosine · hybrid = BM25 + vector + semantic reranker
Each chunk carries [Policy Title — Section N] inline, so citation needs no metadata lookup
temperature 0 · strict JSON schema · decision enum has no APPROVED value
Refuses with a fixed string when the corpus does not cover the question
status ← rule_engine_verdict (never the model) · reason ← model explanation
verdicts_agree → confidence HIGH · disagreement → LOW, flagged for manual review
human_review_required = True — assigned in Python, no code path sets it False
1. Azure AI Content Safety / Prompt Shields — platform, blocks before generation (HTTP 400)
2. System prompt rules 1–8 — grounding, refusal, no approval, retrieved text is data
3. Strict JSON schema — decision enum structurally excludes APPROVED / REJECTED
4. Post-generation code guards — prompt-leak suppression, human_review_required override
The prompt states intent. Code enforces it.
Azure AI Language — PII entity detection
Azure AI Speech — STT and TTS (en-IN)
Triage bands mapped to Complaint Policy §4
All behind one AIServices resource, S0
Spans land in dependencies, not customEvents
Region centralus · Azure for Students · 12 policy documents, 104 indexed chunks, 20 customer applications, 6 image-only scans, 60 customer messages
30 automated tests: 10 RAG accuracy · 5 hallucination · 6 prompt injection · 5 sensitive data · masking · index PII
